ex-02-s3: WITH item_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(subtotal_idr) AS item_subtotal_idr, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE subtotal_idr IS NULL) AS null_item_subtotals FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_checked, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE it.order_id IS NULL OR it.null_item_subtotals > 0 OR it.item_subtotal_idr IS NULL OR o.total_amount_idr IS DISTINCT FROM (it.item_subtotal_idr - COALESCE(o.discount_amount_idr, 0))) AS order_amount_mismatches, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE it.order_id IS NULL OR it.null_item_subtotals > 0 OR it.item_subtotal_idr IS NULL OR o.total_amount_idr IS DISTINCT FROM (it.item_subtotal_idr - COALESCE(o.discount_amount_idr, 0))) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS mismatch_rate_pct FROM orders o LEFT JOIN item_totals it ON it.order_id = o.order_id;

ex-04-s1: WITH monthly_orders AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::DATE AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(o.total_amount_idr) AS revenue_idr, AVG(o.total_amount_idr) AS aov_idr FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY 1), monthly_units AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::DATE AS month, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY 1), combined AS (SELECT mo.*, mu.units_sold FROM monthly_orders mo JOIN monthly_units mu USING (month)) SELECT month, orders, revenue_idr, units_sold, ROUND(aov_idr, 2) AS aov_idr, LAG(revenue_idr) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_revenue_idr, ROUND(100.0 * (revenue_idr - LAG(revenue_idr) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(revenue_idr) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 2) AS revenue_mom_pct, ROUND(100.0 * (orders - LAG(orders) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(orders) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 2) AS orders_mom_pct FROM combined ORDER BY month;

ex-06-s1: WITH product_sales AS (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, SUM(oi.subtotal_idr) AS product_revenue_idr, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY oi.product_id), ranked AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.brand, ps.units_sold, ps.product_revenue_idr, ps.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.units_sold DESC) AS unit_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.product_revenue_idr DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM product_sales ps JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ps.product_id) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE unit_rank <= 10 OR revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY revenue_rank, unit_rank, product_id;
ex-07-s1: WITH product_clean AS (SELECT product_id, brand, sub_category, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'dress' THEN 'Dress' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) IN ('jacket', 'jaket') THEN 'Jaket' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'kaos' THEN 'Kaos' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'kemeja' THEN 'Kemeja' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 't-shirt' THEN 'T-Shirt' ELSE TRIM(category) END AS category_normalized FROM products), sales AS (SELECT pc.category_normalized, pc.sub_category, pc.brand, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, SUM(oi.subtotal_idr) AS revenue_idr, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN product_clean pc ON pc.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY pc.category_normalized, pc.sub_category, pc.brand) SELECT * FROM sales ORDER BY revenue_idr DESC;
ex-07-s2: WITH product_clean AS (SELECT product_id, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'dress' THEN 'Dress' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) IN ('jacket', 'jaket') THEN 'Jaket' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'kaos' THEN 'Kaos' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'kemeja' THEN 'Kemeja' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 't-shirt' THEN 'T-Shirt' ELSE TRIM(category) END AS category_normalized FROM products), category_sales AS (SELECT pc.category_normalized, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, SUM(oi.subtotal_idr) AS revenue_idr FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN product_clean pc ON pc.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY pc.category_normalized) SELECT category_normalized, units_sold, revenue_idr, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_idr DESC) AS revenue_rank, ROUND(100.0 * revenue_idr / SUM(revenue_idr) OVER (), 2) AS revenue_contribution_pct FROM category_sales ORDER BY revenue_rank;
ex-08-s1: WITH product_sales AS (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY oi.product_id), scored AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.brand, p.stock, COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) AS units_sold, CASE WHEN p.stock = 0 AND COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) > 0 THEN 'Out of stock + sold' WHEN p.stock <= 20 AND COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) > 0 THEN 'Low stock + sold' WHEN p.stock >= 150 AND COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) <= 5 THEN 'High stock + low/no sales' WHEN COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) = 0 THEN 'No recorded valid sales' ELSE 'Other' END AS opportunity_flag FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_sales ps ON ps.product_id = p.product_id) SELECT * FROM scored WHERE opportunity_flag <> 'Other' ORDER BY CASE opportunity_flag WHEN 'Out of stock + sold' THEN 1 WHEN 'Low stock + sold' THEN 2 WHEN 'High stock + low/no sales' THEN 3 WHEN 'No recorded valid sales' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, units_sold DESC, stock DESC;
ex-09-s1: WITH product_sales AS (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, SUM(oi.subtotal_idr) AS revenue_idr FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY oi.product_id) SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.category, p.price_idr AS current_price_idr, p.avg_rating, COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) AS units_sold, COALESCE(ps.revenue_idr, 0) AS revenue_idr, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) >= 20 AND p.avg_rating >= 4.5 THEN 'High sales + high rating' WHEN COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) >= 20 AND p.avg_rating < 4.0 THEN 'High sales + lower rating' WHEN COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0) <= 5 AND p.avg_rating >= 4.5 THEN 'Low sales + high rating' ELSE 'Other' END AS product_signal FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_sales ps ON ps.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY units_sold DESC, avg_rating DESC;
ex-09-s2: WITH product_sales AS (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY oi.product_id) SELECT CASE WHEN p.price_idr < 250000 THEN '<250K' WHEN p.price_idr < 500000 THEN '250K-<500K' WHEN p.price_idr < 750000 THEN '500K-<750K' ELSE '>=750K' END AS price_band, COUNT(*) AS products, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0)), 2) AS avg_units_sold_per_product, SUM(COALESCE(ps.units_sold, 0)) AS total_units_sold FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_sales ps ON ps.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(p.price_idr);
ex-10-s1: WITH customer_sales AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.gender, c.age_group, c.city, c.province, COUNT(o.order_id) AS valid_order_count, SUM(o.total_amount_idr) AS revenue_idr, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_valid_order_date, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_valid_order_date FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.gender, c.age_group, c.city, c.province) SELECT COUNT(*) AS buying_customers, ROUND(AVG(valid_order_count), 2) AS avg_orders_per_buying_customer, ROUND(AVG(revenue_idr), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_buying_customer, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE valid_order_count = 1) AS one_time_buyers, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE valid_order_count > 1) AS repeat_buyers, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE valid_order_count > 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS repeat_buyer_rate_pct FROM customer_sales;
ex-10-s2: WITH customer_sales AS (SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.total_amount_idr) AS revenue_idr FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY o.customer_id), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_idr DESC) AS revenue_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS order_rank FROM customer_sales) SELECT customer_id, order_count, revenue_idr, revenue_rank, order_rank, revenue_rank + order_rank AS combined_rank_score FROM ranked ORDER BY combined_rank_score, customer_id LIMIT 25;
ex-11-s1: WITH valid_orders AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')), customer_metrics AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(order_date) AS last_order_date, COUNT(*) AS frequency, SUM(total_amount_idr) AS monetary FROM valid_orders GROUP BY customer_id), reference_date AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_order_date FROM valid_orders), scored AS (SELECT cm.*, (rd.max_order_date - cm.last_order_date) AS recency_days, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY cm.last_order_date ASC) AS r_score, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY cm.frequency) AS f_score, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY cm.monetary) AS m_score FROM customer_metrics cm CROSS JOIN reference_date rd) SELECT customer_id, recency_days, frequency, monetary AS revenue_idr, r_score, f_score, m_score, CASE WHEN r_score >= 3 AND f_score >= 3 AND m_score >= 3 THEN 'High-value active' WHEN f_score >= 3 AND m_score >= 3 THEN 'Frequent high-value' WHEN r_score >= 3 THEN 'Recent buyers' WHEN r_score = 1 AND f_score <= 2 AND m_score <= 2 THEN 'Lapsed low-value' ELSE 'Mid-tier' END AS segment FROM scored ORDER BY revenue_idr DESC;
ex-12-s1: WITH valid_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')), first_purchase AS (SELECT customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(order_date))::DATE AS cohort_month FROM valid_orders GROUP BY customer_id), customer_months AS (SELECT DISTINCT vo.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', vo.order_date)::DATE AS purchase_month FROM valid_orders vo), cohort_activity AS (SELECT fp.cohort_month, cm.purchase_month, COUNT(DISTINCT cm.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM first_purchase fp JOIN customer_months cm ON cm.customer_id = fp.customer_id GROUP BY fp.cohort_month, cm.purchase_month), cohort_sizes AS (SELECT cohort_month, COUNT(*) AS cohort_customers FROM first_purchase GROUP BY cohort_month) SELECT ca.cohort_month, ca.purchase_month, ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ca.purchase_month) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ca.cohort_month)) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ca.purchase_month) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ca.cohort_month))::INT AS month_number, cs.cohort_customers, ca.active_customers, ROUND(100.0 * ca.active_customers / NULLIF(cs.cohort_customers, 0), 2) AS retention_rate_pct FROM cohort_activity ca JOIN cohort_sizes cs USING (cohort_month) ORDER BY ca.cohort_month, month_number;
ex-13-s1: WITH valid_orders AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')), promo_summary AS (SELECT COALESCE(promo_code, 'NO_PROMO') AS promo_code, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(total_amount_idr) AS revenue_idr, AVG(total_amount_idr) AS aov_idr, SUM(COALESCE(discount_amount_idr, 0)) AS discount_idr FROM valid_orders GROUP BY COALESCE(promo_code, 'NO_PROMO')) SELECT promo_code, orders, revenue_idr, ROUND(aov_idr, 2) AS aov_idr, discount_idr, ROUND(100.0 * orders / SUM(orders) OVER (), 2) AS order_share_pct FROM promo_summary ORDER BY revenue_idr DESC;
ex-13-s2: SELECT CASE WHEN promo_code IS NULL THEN 'No promo' ELSE 'Promo used' END AS promo_group, COUNT(*) AS valid_orders, SUM(total_amount_idr) AS revenue_idr, ROUND(AVG(total_amount_idr), 2) AS aov_idr, SUM(COALESCE(discount_amount_idr, 0)) AS discount_idr FROM orders WHERE order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
ex-14-s1: WITH promo_items AS (SELECT oi.product_id, oi.quantity, oi.subtotal_idr FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') AND o.promo_code IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.category, SUM(pi.quantity) AS units_sold, SUM(pi.subtotal_idr) AS item_revenue_idr, COUNT(DISTINCT pi.product_id) AS products_sold FROM promo_items pi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY item_revenue_idr DESC;

ex-15-s1: SELECT courier, COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'returned') AS returned_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'returned') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS return_rate_pct, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'cancelled') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS cancellation_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(shipping_cost_idr), 2) AS avg_shipping_cost_idr FROM orders GROUP BY courier ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC, orders DESC;

ex-17-s1: WITH sales AS (SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, SUM(oi.subtotal_idr) AS revenue_idr FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY oi.product_id), review_stats AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS review_count, AVG(rating) AS avg_review_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY product_id), product_metrics AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.category, COALESCE(s.units_sold, 0) AS units_sold, COALESCE(s.revenue_idr, 0) AS revenue_idr, rs.review_count, rs.avg_review_rating FROM products p LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN review_stats rs ON rs.product_id = p.product_id) SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY units_sold DESC) AS sales_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_review_rating DESC NULLS LAST) AS rating_rank, CASE WHEN avg_review_rating >= 4.5 AND units_sold <= 5 THEN 'High rating + low sales' WHEN avg_review_rating < 3.5 AND units_sold >= 20 THEN 'Lower rating + high sales' ELSE 'Other' END AS experience_signal FROM product_metrics WHERE review_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN avg_review_rating >= 4.5 AND units_sold <= 5 THEN 'High rating + low sales' WHEN avg_review_rating < 3.5 AND units_sold >= 20 THEN 'Lower rating + high sales' ELSE 'Other' END) <> 'Other' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, avg_review_rating DESC NULLS LAST, units_sold DESC;
ex-18-s1: WITH valid_order_products AS (SELECT DISTINCT oi.order_id, oi.product_id FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')), pairs AS (SELECT a.product_id AS product_a, b.product_id AS product_b, COUNT(*) AS order_pair_count FROM valid_order_products a JOIN valid_order_products b ON a.order_id = b.order_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id, b.product_id) SELECT p1.name AS product_a, p2.name AS product_b, pairs.order_pair_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pairs.order_pair_count DESC) AS pair_rank FROM pairs JOIN products p1 ON p1.product_id = pairs.product_a JOIN products p2 ON p2.product_id = pairs.product_b ORDER BY pair_rank, product_a, product_b LIMIT 30;
ex-19-s1: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id) AS customer_order_count, SUM(o.total_amount_idr) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id) AS customer_revenue FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')), customer_segment AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, CASE WHEN customer_order_count >= 5 AND customer_revenue >= 5000000 THEN 'High-value repeat' WHEN customer_order_count >= 2 THEN 'Repeat' ELSE 'One-time' END AS customer_segment FROM customer_orders), product_clean AS (SELECT product_id, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'dress' THEN 'Dress' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) IN ('jacket', 'jaket') THEN 'Jaket' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'kaos' THEN 'Kaos' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'kemeja' THEN 'Kemeja' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 't-shirt' THEN 'T-Shirt' ELSE TRIM(category) END AS category_normalized FROM products) SELECT cs.customer_segment, pc.category_normalized, COUNT(DISTINCT co.customer_id) AS customers, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, SUM(oi.subtotal_idr) AS item_revenue_idr, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.customer_segment ORDER BY SUM(oi.subtotal_idr) DESC) AS category_rank_within_segment FROM customer_orders co JOIN customer_segment cs ON cs.customer_id = co.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = co.order_id JOIN product_clean pc ON pc.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY cs.customer_segment, pc.category_normalized ORDER BY cs.customer_segment, category_rank_within_segment;

ex-04-s2:
WITH monthly_order_metrics AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)::DATE AS month,
           COUNT(*) AS valid_orders,
           SUM(total_amount_idr) AS revenue_idr
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')
    GROUP BY 1
),
monthly_units AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::DATE AS month,
           SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')
    GROUP BY 1
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT m.month, m.revenue_idr, m.valid_orders, u.units_sold
    FROM monthly_order_metrics m
    JOIN monthly_units u USING (month)
)
SELECT month, revenue_idr, valid_orders, units_sold
FROM monthly
WHERE revenue_idr = (SELECT MAX(revenue_idr) FROM monthly)
ORDER BY month;
ex-07-s3:
WITH brand_sales AS (
    SELECT p.brand,
           SUM(oi.subtotal_idr) AS revenue_idr,
           SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')
    GROUP BY p.brand
)
SELECT brand, revenue_idr, units_sold,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_idr DESC) AS revenue_rank,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY units_sold DESC) AS units_rank
FROM brand_sales
ORDER BY revenue_rank, units_rank, brand;
ex-05-s5:
WITH valid_orders AS (
    SELECT shipping_city, shipping_province, total_amount_idr
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')
),
location_sales AS (
    SELECT shipping_city, shipping_province,
           COUNT(*) AS valid_orders,
           SUM(total_amount_idr) AS revenue_idr
    FROM valid_orders
    GROUP BY shipping_city, shipping_province
),
total AS (
    SELECT SUM(total_amount_idr) AS total_revenue_idr
    FROM valid_orders
)
SELECT ls.shipping_city, ls.shipping_province, ls.valid_orders, ls.revenue_idr,
       ROUND(100.0 * ls.revenue_idr / NULLIF(t.total_revenue_idr, 0), 2) AS revenue_contribution_pct
FROM location_sales ls
CROSS JOIN total t
ORDER BY ls.revenue_idr DESC, ls.shipping_province, ls.shipping_city;
ex-09-s3:
WITH valid_product_items AS (
    SELECT oi.product_id, oi.order_id, oi.quantity, oi.subtotal_idr
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.price_idr,
           COALESCE(SUM(vpi.quantity), 0) AS units_sold,
           COALESCE(SUM(vpi.subtotal_idr), 0) AS product_revenue_idr
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN valid_product_items vpi ON vpi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.price_idr
),
banded AS (
    SELECT *,
           CASE WHEN price_idr < 100000 THEN 'Under 100k'
                WHEN price_idr < 250000 THEN '100k-249,999'
                WHEN price_idr < 500000 THEN '250k-499,999'
                ELSE '500k+' END AS price_band
    FROM product_sales
)
SELECT price_band,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE units_sold > 0) AS products_sold,
       SUM(units_sold) AS units_sold,
       SUM(product_revenue_idr) AS product_revenue_idr
FROM banded
GROUP BY price_band
ORDER BY MIN(price_idr);
ex-08-s2:
WITH valid_product_items AS (
    SELECT oi.product_id, oi.quantity
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.brand, p.stock AS current_stock,
           COALESCE(SUM(vpi.quantity), 0) AS units_sold
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN valid_product_items vpi ON vpi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.brand, p.stock
)
SELECT product_id, name, brand, units_sold, current_stock
FROM product_sales
WHERE current_stock <= 5
  AND units_sold > 0
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, current_stock ASC, product_id;
ex-10-s3:
WITH customer_order_metrics AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, c.age_group,
           COUNT(o.order_id) AS valid_orders,
           SUM(o.total_amount_idr) AS revenue_idr
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender, c.age_group
)
SELECT gender, age_group,
       COUNT(*) AS buying_customers,
       SUM(valid_orders) AS valid_orders,
       SUM(revenue_idr) AS revenue_idr,
       ROUND(SUM(revenue_idr)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(valid_orders), 0), 2) AS aov_idr
FROM customer_order_metrics
GROUP BY gender, age_group
ORDER BY gender, age_group;
ex-10-s4:
SELECT c.city AS customer_city, c.province AS customer_province,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS buying_customers,
       COUNT(o.order_id) AS valid_orders,
       SUM(o.total_amount_idr) AS revenue_idr
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')
GROUP BY c.city, c.province
ORDER BY revenue_idr DESC, valid_orders DESC, customer_province, customer_city;
ex-10-s5:
WITH customer_sales AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.name,
           COUNT(*) AS valid_orders,
           SUM(o.total_amount_idr) AS revenue_idr
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
),
with_contribution AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROUND(100.0 * revenue_idr / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_idr) OVER (), 0), 2) AS revenue_contribution_pct,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_idr DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM customer_sales
)
SELECT customer_id, name, valid_orders, revenue_idr, revenue_contribution_pct, revenue_rank
FROM with_contribution
ORDER BY revenue_rank, valid_orders DESC, customer_id
;
ex-13-s3:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)::DATE AS month,
       CASE WHEN promo_code IS NULL THEN 'No promo' ELSE 'Promo' END AS promo_group,
       COUNT(*) AS valid_orders,
       SUM(total_amount_idr) AS revenue_idr,
       ROUND(AVG(total_amount_idr), 2) AS aov_idr
FROM orders
WHERE order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)::DATE,
         CASE WHEN promo_code IS NULL THEN 'No promo' ELSE 'Promo' END
ORDER BY month, promo_group;
ex-13-s4:
SELECT promo_code,
       COUNT(*) AS valid_orders,
       SUM(total_amount_idr) AS revenue_idr,
       ROUND(AVG(total_amount_idr), 2) AS aov_idr,
       SUM(COALESCE(discount_amount_idr, 0)) AS discount_amount_idr
FROM orders
WHERE order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')
  AND promo_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY promo_code
ORDER BY valid_orders DESC, aov_idr ASC, promo_code;
ex-15-s4:
SELECT courier,
       COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'delivered') AS delivered_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'shipped') AS shipped_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'processing') AS processing_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'returned') AS returned_orders,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'cancelled') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS cancel_rate_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'returned') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM orders
GROUP BY courier
ORDER BY total_orders DESC, courier;
ex-15-s5:
SELECT shipping_city, shipping_province,
       COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'returned') AS returned_orders,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'returned') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM orders
GROUP BY shipping_city, shipping_province
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20

ex-16-s5:
SELECT p.category, p.brand,
       COUNT(r.review_id) AS review_count,
       ROUND(AVG(r.rating)::NUMERIC, 2) AS avg_review_rating,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.product_id) AS distinct_products_reviewed
FROM reviews r
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id
WHERE r.rating IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.category, p.brand
ORDER BY avg_review_rating DESC, review_count DESC, p.category, p.brand;
ex-01-s4:
WITH source_rows AS (
    SELECT 'customers' AS table_name, to_jsonb(t) AS row_data FROM customers t
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'products', to_jsonb(t) FROM products t
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'orders', to_jsonb(t) FROM orders t
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'order_items', to_jsonb(t) FROM order_items t
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'reviews', to_jsonb(t) FROM reviews t
),
expanded AS (
    SELECT sr.table_name, kv.key AS column_name, kv.value AS column_value
    FROM source_rows sr
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(sr.row_data) AS kv(key, value)
),
column_missing AS (
    SELECT table_name, column_name,
           COUNT(*) AS row_count,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE column_value = 'null'::JSONB) AS missing_count
    FROM expanded
    GROUP BY table_name, column_name
)
SELECT table_name, column_name, row_count, missing_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * missing_count / NULLIF(row_count, 0), 2) AS missing_pct
FROM column_missing
ORDER BY table_name, column_name;
ex-20-s4:
WITH valid_product_items AS (
    SELECT oi.product_id, oi.quantity, oi.subtotal_idr
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')
),
valid_product_sales AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, p.name, p.brand, p.stock,
           COALESCE(SUM(vpi.quantity), 0) AS units_sold,
           COALESCE(SUM(vpi.subtotal_idr), 0) AS product_revenue_idr
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN valid_product_items vpi ON vpi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.brand, p.stock
),
inventory_signals AS (
    SELECT 'Inventory'::TEXT AS priority_area,
           'High unit sales with current stock <= 5'::TEXT AS evidence_item,
           'Units sold and current stock'::TEXT AS supporting_metric,
           CONCAT('units=', units_sold, '; stock=', stock) AS metric_value,
           'Review replenishment; stock is a current snapshot only.'::TEXT AS interpretation_note
    FROM valid_product_sales
    WHERE units_sold > 0 AND stock <= 5
    ORDER BY units_sold DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
review_signals AS (
    SELECT 'Customer experience'::TEXT AS priority_area,
           CONCAT('Low average review rating for product ', p.product_id, ' (', p.name, ')') AS evidence_item,
           'Average review rating and review count'::TEXT AS supporting_metric,
           CONCAT('rating=', ROUND(AVG(r.rating)::NUMERIC, 2), '; reviews=', COUNT(r.review_id)) AS metric_value,
           'Investigate review text and product context; rating alone does not prove cause.'::TEXT AS interpretation_note
    FROM products p
    JOIN reviews r ON r.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE r.rating IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
    HAVING COUNT(r.review_id) >= 5
    ORDER BY AVG(r.rating) ASC
    LIMIT 5
),
location_signals AS (
    SELECT 'Operations'::TEXT AS priority_area,
           CONCAT('High return rate at ', shipping_city, ', ', shipping_province) AS evidence_item,
           'Return rate and order volume'::TEXT AS supporting_metric,
           CONCAT('return_rate_pct=', ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'returned') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2), '; orders=', COUNT(*)) AS metric_value,
           'Use as a review signal; returned orders / all orders. Minimum 20 orders.'::TEXT AS interpretation_note
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY shipping_city, shipping_province
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'returned')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT * FROM inventory_signals
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM review_signals
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM location_signals
ORDER BY priority_area, evidence_item;
